gui.jaymoskingdoms.magic.sub.rituals: Cast standing still, a book open
gui.jaymoskingdoms.magic.sub.sorcery: Spells you keep: one press casts
gui.jaymoskingdoms.magic.sub.choices: What your spells call up: click to change
gui.jaymoskingdoms.magic.none: You know no spells of this kind yet.
magic.jaymoskingdoms.cantrip.light.desc: A steady glow at your staff's tip, or your fingertip, that goes where you go. Cast it again to put it out.
magic.jaymoskingdoms.cantrip.mend.desc: Knits a cracked tool in your hand a little. It will not take with a fight on.
magic.jaymoskingdoms.cantrip.clean.desc: Washes the blood off your coat and everything you wear.
magic.jaymoskingdoms.cantrip.warm.desc: Warms the dish in your hand. Eaten, it warms your body a while.
magic.jaymoskingdoms.cantrip.chill.desc: Cools the dish in your hand. Eaten, it cools your body a while.
magic.jaymoskingdoms.cantrip.whisper.des: A few words to someone in sight, in a bubble over you that only they see. Click, type them, look at them and press Enter.
magic.jaymoskingdoms.cantrip.weather.des: Tells you what tomorrow brings, and any disaster foretold.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.call_familia: Calls your familiar back from its ash.
magic.jaymoskingdoms.choice.send.desc: Sends your familiar off to where you are looking.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.magic.hint.kinds: Point at a kind of magic and click to see its spells.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.magic.hint.spells: Point at a spell to read it, click to cast. Right click or the middle goes back.
